references.observation: This commit introduces the v0.5 native-speech change set and states that v0.4-and-earlier undeclared speech migrates as espeak while new v0.5 undeclared speech defaults to native.
normalize_project accepts project schemas v0.1 through v0.5, emits canonical schema v0.5, and chooses espeak for undeclared speech in older schemas while choosing native for v0.5.
The regression test_project_schema_migrates_legacy_speech_without_rewriting_its_engine checks that v0.4 undeclared speech normalizes to espeak and v0.5 undeclared speech normalizes to native.
The v0.8 changelog records the intended semantic split: new v0.5 speech defaults to native while v0.4-and-earlier undeclared speech migrates as espeak to preserve historical intent.
